The Bajaj Pulsar NS200 has been updated with a host of new features. It gets an electronic throttle body with five riding modes, a quickshifter, traction control and a TFT display with Bluetooth connectivity and navigation. It also gets adjustable brake and clutch levers, along with a radial rear tyre. We bring you a quick review of the motorcycle.
Cameraperson: Harshad Panchal
